data.turoyo: Ak karkuš, məd maṭən, kquṭfənne, ksaymi maye d qaṭmo w kġayṭi suġlo b suġlo bam maye du qaṭmano,
data.translation: Wenn die karkūš-Trauben reif sind, pflückt man sie, man bereitet Aschenlauge vor und taucht eine Traube nach der anderen in diese Aschenlauge.

rationale: Fourth original Infectum I.1 example; grape dipping with explicitly prepared medium.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (94/151)

data.turoyo: An naʕəmkat, kosaymənne ṣlibe, mḥaləlkat w barankat. Hanək ste, koġaytənnene bi ḥawdal, lu tešteʕənyo, koməštaʕən appe. Ha u šuġlo di širaniye kule hawxa bu šəklano kowe.
data.translation: Die Kinder machen daraus kreuze, "Hahnenkämme" (Spielzeugaus nebeneinander gelegten Weinranken mit einem kleinen Faden zum anfassen). und "Hämmelchen" aus demselben Material und tauchen sie auch in ḥaudal, zum Spielen; sie spielen damit. So werden alle Trauben Süßigkeiten hergestellt.

rationale: Unusual source form with plain t and extra -ne merits preservation beyond the ordinary cell quota; no morphology is silently repaired.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/129)

data.turoyo: ʕOlíqene hani, mal+luze ŭ mag+gawze flān ŭ mat+tene hən saymiwa, mat+teneste, tene našife, nəšfiwa at+tene, maltmiwa, saymiwa mánəkste ʕayni mede, ġayṭíwanne bgawe di+ḥalilayo… di+ḥawdal.
data.translation: They’re walnut ropes, these ones, made from almonds or from walnuts, so and so, and from figs, some would make them, from figs too, dry figs, the figs would dry, they would collect them, they would make those too, the same thing, they would dip them inside that fruit leather… inside the pudding.

rationale: Second Infectum-wa I.1 example; plural patient.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq old houses/91)

data.turoyo: Aʕ+ʕənwaṯṯe, dəmmina, meqəm quṭfíwanne mas+sate, mak+karme. Ġayṭíwanne bam+maye, šəkəl dmaye, saymiwa šəkəl dmaye. Maye du+zeyoto kummínanne.
data.translation: Their grapes, so to speak, formerly we used to pluck them from vines, from vineyards. We dipped them in water, a kind of water, we made a kind of water. We call it a cold dip.

rationale: Third Infectum-wa I.1 example; independent source with grapes.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE Famine/38)

data.turoyo: Ġayṭíwaynala dlo+ḥwoṭo, ġayṭíwaynala bi+rawmo bi+rawmo bi+rawmo tarte+tlaṯ+kore, ŭ bəṯr edi g̊ḥawṭíwaynala hul dhuyowa sibore.
data.translation: We would immerse it without beating, we would immerse it in the pond, in the pond, in the pond two-three times, and then we would beat it until it would become multicoloured.

rationale: Fourth Infectum-wa I.1 example; feminine cloth patient and repeated immersion distinguished from beating.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (67/39)

data.turoyo: Hawi, twir u lalyo, ḥəlle, kaṯi rawixo, səsyo komo taḥte, hiye komo, ko ʕarše maḥawri b feme w aṯi, ġətle i rumḥo qum qarʕe du babo.
data.translation: und las in seinem buche. Als mittemachtvorüber war, sah er einen Reiter kommen, auf einem schwarzen Pferde. Er ist ganz schwarz, die Zähne blitzen ihm weiß im Munde. Er kam und stieß seine Lanze vor dem Haupte des Vaters in die Erde

rationale: Third Preterit example; preserves source ġətle beside ġəṭle.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (75/147)

data.turoyo: Qayəm mədle me sawke w azze ġəṭle bi ʕayno du semo, w daʕər ġəṭle bi ʕayno du dahwo.
data.translation: Da packte er ihn an den Haaren, ging und tauchte ihn in den Silberbrunnen, und wiederum in den Goldbrunnen.

rationale: Fourth Preterit example; human patient understood, two dipping events in one source context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (PrS 42/13)

data.turoyo: Maḥatle lu paša qm i xazne qiro w zafto, w rəṣle aʕle ʕafro. Ayna d oṯe gonu gmiġəṭ bu qiro w bu zafto, lə knofəq, gməsakle u paša.
data.translation: Der Statthalter hatte vor dem Schatze eine Grube voll Pech und Harz angelegt und Erde darüber streuen lassen, damit jeder, der etwa stehlen würde, in das Pech und Harz einsinke und nicht mehr herauskomme, so dass man ihn fassen könne.

rationale: Second Detransitive Infectum example; involuntary immersion in a trap.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (61/94)

data.turoyo: Komər l Mirza Mḥamma mədle li xanǧarayḏe grišola me qəm ruḥe w məḥyole bi ḥayye, ʕabiro b qḏola w ġiṭo bu šuro, w ṭəryole tamo.
data.translation: Mirza Muḥamma griffnach seinem Dolch, zog ihn aus dem Gürtel und stach ihn in die Schlange hinein. Der dolchdrang in ihren Hals und fuhr dann noch in die Wand hinein. Dort ließ er ihn stecken.

rationale: Third Detransitive Preterit example; dagger enters a wall, contrasting with weapon as active object.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infinitiv (96/222)

data.turoyo: Omər aṯyo i gammiye l fəlge du baḥar w aṯyo l ġyoṭo, tuyo ġawr.
data.translation: Als das Schiff in die Mitte des Meeres gekommen war, war es nahe daran, unterzugehen und abzusacken.

rationale: Second Detransitive Infinitiv example; literal sinking of a ship clarifies the box beyond inherited sunset.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infinitiv (Talay 1/75)

data.turoyo: Lalye d tloṯo fayəš saʕaye mede l ġyoṭe d yawmo. Aṯən, naḥiti gabi w šralle raġloṯi <...>
data.translation: In der Nacht zu Dienstag, eine Stunde vor Sonnenuntergang, kamen sie wieder zu mir herunter, lösten meine Füße (von den Ketten),

rationale: Third Detransitive Infinitiv example; temporal sunset use contrasts with inherited westward direction.

summary: Active transitive dipping takes a patient plus b-, bayn or bgawe medium/container. Food preparation, dyeing, religious sprinkling and metal immersion do not each require technical senses.
Preterit Intransitive ġayiṭo and Detransitive ġiṭ/ġiṭo overlap in sinking/result states. Preserve their attested forms rather than derive grammatical voice from a German rendering.
Detransitive may describe involuntary entry of a person into tar, a dagger into a wall, or static immersion in feathers; no expressed external agent is necessary.
The Infinitiv sunset expression is inherited. Directional ġyoṭe and literal sinking of a ship show the nominal uses without proving a new finite paradigm.
94/151: confirm plain t and extra -ne in koġaytənnene; preserve the printed form pending recording/edition verification.
95/39: inherited miġoṭo and assigned miġoto differ in emphatic spelling; verify the source before making a fix-text correction.
Confirm the scope of ġoyəṭ ʕal lebe fainting from the existing example with grammar reference 517; no new corpus quotation is available here.
Check PrS 42/15,21 versus inherited prs 117/12,21 edition mappings. These are already quoted passages and are not duplicated or silently recited.
Correct the German genitive adjective ending
rationale: After genitive singular eines, the adjective requires -en. The supplied translation of 12/9 repeats this grammatical typo.

summary: Restore the missing g in Pfingsttage

summary: Detransitive Infinitiv ġyoṭe d yawmo denotes sunset and can identify the west; the solar participant extends sinking, and bare direction uses are lexicalized nominal uses.
